goal: Enforce collision-safe draw, resize, move, rigid multi-select/group and paste placement sessions in the controlled React Flow canvas without persisting transient session state.
non_goals: Do not change the approved pure collision, spatial-index, viewport-sizing or nearest-free placement contracts unless an actual integration defect requires a minimal compatible fix.
Do not change relation creation or routing behavior, AI operations, chat, credentials, persistence schemas, packaging or release behavior.
Do not add or upgrade dependencies.
Do not export transient invalid, snap-guide, legacy-conflict or selection-glow state through CanvasNodeData, history or the database.
Do not read, print or modify provider credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid draw release creates no node and no history checkpoint; invalid resize restores the latest authoritative legal geometry and writes no checkpoint.
pointercancel, lostpointercapture and window blur cancel draw, resize and move sessions, clear previews/guides, release capture when held and write no history.
Draw and resize use independent x/y soft snap with 8-screen-pixel entry, a 6-screen-pixel safety boundary and a 14-screen-pixel break distance; overlapping previews are visibly invalid.
Image resize applies its aspect-ratio constraint before collision validation.
Normal movement uses swept rigid collision, slides without tunneling, and successful gestures push exactly one checkpoint.
Multi-selection preserves relative member positions and internal conflicts while preventing new or increasing external conflicts.
Group children participate as individual solid rectangles rather than one filled group bounding box.
Stale-authority cancellation keeps external active-node geometry and revalidates obstacle-only changes against the newest spatial-index version.
Legacy conflict acceptance uses unordered baseline pair identities, non-increasing retained-pair MTD and a strictly improved or zero final lexicographic score.

Paste, duplicate, picker and external drop run through nearest-free placement, a 120ms preview and newest-index revalidation before one history/add commit; new resources are cleaned up on placement failure.
Spatial index content versions are rebuilt or incremented after load, create, move, resize, delete, undo, redo and document replacement.
Focused collision-session and editor-contract tests, the complete canvas suite, TypeScript and diff checks pass with no direct unvalidated solid-node position or dimension acceptance path.
The implementation is committed and independently reviewed for specification compliance and task quality.
notes: Read the Task 5 brief first and follow strict TDD, recording the initial focused failures before implementation.
Treat the React editor as an explicit manual context boundary while the two pure collision/placement entrypoints anchor the bounded L2 slice.
Capture one immutable ViewportSnapshot and baseline authoritative geometry per gesture session.
Use the existing spatial index for broad phase and pure collision policy for exact checks; do not duplicate geometry semantics in React code.
Keep all invalid-preview, guide, conflict and glow state transient and editor-only.
Preserve one successful gesture or placement as one undo checkpoint and every cancellation as zero checkpoints.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for every non-ASCII read, search, edit and test output.
Do not expose or change configured provider secrets.
